observations.symbols_or_scope: PROD-01/02/03/04/09/11/12; custom Board and generic SDK threat boundaries
observations.current_behavior_or_authority: Native scalar/nsec recovery, one active identity, local operation authority and lifecycle qualification are accepted requirements. Optional NIP06 migration and one trusted firmware image do not imply arbitrary-app isolation.
observations.consequence: Use these requirements over inherited part names, fixtures and source behavior.

observations.symbols_or_scope: workspace members; product dependency and session module declarations
observations.current_behavior_or_authority: Product workspace consists of core and desktop-simulator. Core dependency declarations are sha2/zeroize; inspected session source is RAM-only. No persistent PIN/SE/owner-root implementation is present in these product source trees.
observations.consequence: There is no existing persistent protocol to bless or repair by merely replacing a boolean. Absence claim excludes research/vendor and unrelated repositories.

observations.current_behavior_or_authority: Scalar input validates range and clears mutable input; raw borrow is crate-private; secret types are not Clone/Copy and Debug redacts. Keyring stores up to eight sources inline and clears current owned fields.
observations.consequence: Eight slots do not establish a multi-account product. Software privacy and Drop do not protect against arbitrary privileged firmware, moves, DMA or backend temporary exposure.

observations.current_behavior_or_authority: Generation-named functions convert caller-provided scalar/entropy. They invoke no entropy provider.
observations.consequence: New custody must use qualified fallible entropy and preserve source-to-device evidence; no entropy qualification inferred from valid scalar syntax.

observations.current_behavior_or_authority: Account selection validates supplied fields, source fingerprint and route/path, without deriving the public key; source_public_key_proof_verified remains false. Replay verifies public-key shape, not derivation. Source fingerprint is truncated domain-separated hash metadata.
observations.consequence: An expected-key recovery drill requires actual derivation and independent expected identity; fingerprint/shape/equal copied descriptor is not its oracle.

observations.current_behavior_or_authority: Import consumes source and simulated button input, loading only after the flow approves. Backup flow constructs an explicit secret payload after its software review; IO borrows it then drops it. Caller/output adapter still owns copies.
observations.consequence: Physical input provenance and secret display/camera/framebuffer cleanup are target obligations. Backup API restrictions do not isolate hostile code in the trusted image.
